dod_intent_evidence: SBIR portfolio record (sbir.gov, via channel notes) shows an Army sensor-data-integrity requirement, and the News section shows Walacor was assessed 'Awardable' on the CDAO's Tradewinds Solutions Marketplace (2026-03-31) plus a Carahsoft public-sector reseller partnership.
score_evidence: 'Patent-pending Trust-first technology' / 'Quantum Safe Sealed Envelopes' → lab_language_intensity

blind_spots.blind_spot: Deployment model is 'one-click' cloud (AWS/Azure) with no on-prem/edge/disconnected story articulated for the government use case.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A DDIL site has no reachable AWS/Azure control plane — the 'few clicks and minimal investment' cloud-launch model simply doesn't run.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Product originated as a commercial data-integrity/database platform (MortgageTech, cybersecurity) and DoD messaging was layered on top without re-architecting for edge deployment.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Deploy, Test, and Run the Walacor Platform on Amazon Web Services with just a few clicks and minimal investment.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Claims trust from 'military, and space sectors' with zero specific compliance vocabulary (ATO, RMF, IL4/IL5, STIG, CMMC).
blind_spots.operator_reality: A program office won't grant an ATO on marketing language alone — without demonstrated RMF/STIG readiness, the pilot stalls in accreditation regardless of encryption quality.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Company is compliance-adjacent (audit/integrity) but frames it as an enterprise IT capability, not a government-accreditation capability, suggesting the ATO conversation hasn't happened yet.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Trusted by public, commercial, military, intelligence, and space sectors, Walacor's secure data platform provides unmatched protection against ransomware, AI tampering, and accidental data manipulation.

blind_spots.blind_spot: No mention anywhere of who operates/maintains this at the edge — sustainment, training, or field support model is entirely absent.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A sensor-integrity product tied to an Army sensor-data requirement needs someone at the unit level who can operate and troubleshoot it without a helpdesk ticket to Bethesda.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The product's mental model is enterprise SaaS support (ticket-based, always-connected), not field sustainment.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Built for all industries, Walacor's technology is accessible to businesses of all sizes, making it an ideal solution for security and IT departments looking to improve their data security.

opener_hook: Walacor's SBIR abstract targets Army sensor-data integrity, but the public product pages describe one-click AWS/Azure deployment — worth comparing to what the pilot site's comms actually look like.
what_they_do: An immutable, encrypted data-integrity platform (data vault / audit log) sold across commercial, mortgage, and government/military/intelligence sectors.
